name: Cairanne

limits: For red wine, Grenache: at least 40%
For red wine, Carignan, Cinsault, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 20%
For white wine, any two of Clairette, Grenache Blanc and Roussanne together: at least 70%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A Rhône Valley appellation in the southern Rhône, in the Vaucluse, for red and white wine, mainly from Grenache, Clairette, Grenache Blanc and Roussanne.
